cands.name: Zack Hawkins
cands.bio: Democrat who has represented North Carolina House District 31 since January 2019, succeeding Henry Michaux Jr. Former 1st Vice Chair of the NC Democratic Party. Former Durham Public Schools biology teacher. Fundraising and advancement professional at United Way, ECU, Duke and UNC.

endorsements.text: Sierra Club North Carolina endorsed him in 2026, according to Ballotpedia.
The voter-guide groups Fair Map Fight Club and NC Public School Champions recommended him in 2026, according to Ballotpedia.
Then-Rep. Mickey Michaux, his predecessor, endorsed him for the NC House seat. The endorsement is quoted on Hawkins's campaign site.

cands.gaps: We could not find where Hawkins was born or raised, or when he came to North Carolina. We found no stated or documented positions from him on data centers, development or growth limits, homestead property taxes, foreign or institutional land buying, immigration or H-1B, policing, guns or abortion. We found no sponsored-bill details or other deeds that could be matched to those issues. We found no controversies or foreign ties in the pages we reviewed. We also could not see his committee assignments for the current term.

score.why: Raised $0, under $5,000 for this office: too little money to score fairly.

qual.background: Member of the NC House since 2019, seven years, with assignments on Appropriations committees. Earlier worked as a high school teacher and as a development professional at nonprofits and universities.
qual.why: Seven years of prior legislative service fits the top band. The budget-related career is fundraising rather than policy or budget writing, so the score sits at the low end of that band. Committee seats were not counted.
